svg.title: 102 unit squares in a square of side 10.605828708
svg.desc: n = 102; s = 10.605828708. Unit squares, centre (x, y) and rotation theta (radians) about the centre given on each polygon as data-x, data-y, data-theta; the box is [0, s]^2 with y up. Verified legal: exact-arithmetic certificate and an independent 60-digit separating-axis check (min wall clearance 5e-10, min pair gap 1e-9).
